benchmark.category: an online casino lobby with real-money RUB slots and original mini-games, Russian UI, with an admin back office
benchmark.users: Russian-speaking players who deposit RUB and play provider slots and Dice/Wheel/Bubbles/Mines from phone and desktop; an administrator who manages the game catalog, promo codes and player records

requirements.source_phrase: Давай теперь подключим слоты реальные настоящие с валютой rub
requirements.statement: /slot lists real World Gaming Connect games as tiles and clicking a tile starts that game in RUB against the signed-in player's own RUB balance, not a demo or a fixture game
requirements.notes: Explicit request for real provider slots in RUB; the currency the game plays in and the balance it moves are invisible to a frontend check, hence the counterpart.

requirements.source_phrase: Давай теперь подключим слоты реальные настоящие с валютой rub
requirements.statement: The launch endpoint behind /playslot?g=<publicId> asks the WGC API for a session in currency RUB for the signed-in player with operator credentials read from the server environment and returns a playable session URL; a provider refusal returns an error and moves no balance
requirements.notes: Build reports a REAL WGC live session in the iframe; no bets may be placed inside the game during testing.

requirements.source_phrase: Там есть так же картинки на слотах их тоже можно получить
requirements.statement: Every tile on /slot shows the provider-supplied image belonging to that specific game, never a placeholder, a repeated generic picture or an empty grey block
requirements.notes: The user pointed out that the provider exposes game images and expects them used on the tiles.

requirements.source_phrase: Там есть так же картинки на слотах их тоже можно получить
requirements.statement: The stored game catalog holds every game imported from the WGC games API with its public id, name, provider and image URL, and the /slot listing returns those fields per game; a game whose image URL is missing is returned with an empty image field rather than a broken one
requirements.notes: Catalog reported at 19103 games (17375 slots) with square 300x300 images from img.worldgamingconnect.com; this requirement is the data source several frontend requirements read.

requirements.source_phrase: Смотри лого на картинках есть оно должно полностью помещаться на картинке
requirements.statement: Each /slot tile displays the whole source image, including the provider logo drawn inside it, with no crop, zoom or blur frame, so the logo is fully visible inside the tile
requirements.notes: The logo lives inside the artwork, so any cropping cuts it; the check must compare the rendered tile against the source image.

requirements.source_phrase: названия не нужно на них оставлять чтобы оно было написано перед слотом
requirements.statement: No game-name text is drawn over the tile image on /slot; the name is rendered as ordinary text outside the image area, beside or above the tile, and never covers the artwork
requirements.notes: The user said the name is already in the picture and should be written before the slot, not on top of it.

requirements.source_phrase: Сделай их 4:3 где-то так чтобы они полностью помещались не квадратные
requirements.statement: Slot tiles on /slot use a roughly 4:3 non-square frame and the full game image fits inside it with nothing clipped at top or bottom, on both phone and desktop widths
requirements.notes: Latest explicit instruction is 4:3 and 'not square', while the developer's own test list describes square tiles; the user's line governs. Source images are 300x300, so a 4:3 frame must letterbox rather than crop.

requirements.source_phrase: в сортировке слотов сделай так чтобы не в право надо было метать а сделай так чтобы через стрелку открываешь листаешь вниз и можешь выбрать слот
requirements.statement: The provider control on /slot is a button with an arrow that opens a panel whose list scrolls vertically; choosing a provider filters the grid to that provider's games; no horizontally scrolling provider strip exists on the page
requirements.notes: The user rejected a horizontally scrolled list and asked for an arrow-opened, vertically scrolled selector; the build names data-testid=slots-provider-toggle and slots-provider-list.

requirements.source_phrase: зачем там два поиска в слотах один надо удалить
requirements.statement: /slot renders exactly one search input labelled for game or provider search; typing a game name such as Sweet narrows the grid to matching games and no second search field exists anywhere on the page
requirements.notes: Explicit instruction to remove the duplicate search input; the remaining field must still return results by game name.

requirements.source_phrase: при нажатии на них слот будет открываться
requirements.statement: Clicking or tapping a slot tile navigates to /playslot?g=<that game's public id> and the chosen game starts, with the tile itself, not a small link inside it, as the click target
requirements.notes: Also the user's closing line that only the pictures should remain on the tile; the whole image is the button.

requirements.source_phrase: дам тебе полную документацию все ключи и так далее
requirements.statement: The provider secret and operator credentials are read from server-side configuration (SLOTS_API_SECRET and the WGC operator settings) and never appear in any HTML page, JavaScript bundle, JSON response or log line
requirements.notes: The secret value in the transcript is redacted, so the test can only assert absence, never sign with it.

requirements.statement: The app talks to the WGC API at the documented base URL api.worldgamingconnect.com using the documented request shapes for game list, launch and wallet callbacks, and the game list and launch results come from that API rather than from hardcoded fixtures
requirements.notes: The user supplied the API documentation, the back-office link and the user guide as the contract for the integration.

requirements.statement: A signed-out visitor clicking a slot tile on /slot sees an explicit login-required card on /playslot and no game starts; after signing in the visitor is returned to that same game
requirements.notes: Unstated half of clicking a tile: a game cannot be launched without a player. Build names data-testid=slot-login-required.

requirements.statement: A launch request for a game arriving without a signed-in session is refused with a redirect to login or an auth error, creates no provider session and moves no balance
requirements.notes: The frontend login card can be bypassed by calling the launch route directly.

requirements.statement: Choosing the all-providers option in the provider panel clears the filter and returns the grid to the unfiltered first page
requirements.notes: Paranoid half of the filter: a filter the user cannot undo traps them in one provider's catalog.

requirements.statement: Choosing a provider writes the filter into the URL (/slot?brand=...) and reloading that URL shows the same filtered games, while browser back restores the previous filter and page
requirements.notes: Build states the filter lands in /slot?brand=; the selected state must survive reload and back navigation.

requirements.statement: Clicking anywhere outside the open provider panel closes it without changing the filter, and the toggle button returns to its closed state
requirements.notes: Unstated interaction half of an arrow-opened panel; the build claims it works, so it must be checked.

requirements.statement: A search on /slot that matches no game shows an explicit nothing-found message and the full grid returns when the query is cleared; the page never stays blank or on a spinner
requirements.notes: Zero-row case of the single search field.

requirements.statement: Pagination on /slot moves between pages: the next control shows a different set of games, the previous control returns to the earlier set, and a control is not offered when there is no such page
requirements.notes: The catalog holds ~19,000 games, so a list that cannot be paged is unusable; build states Дальше/Назад controls.

requirements.statement: Requesting /slot with a page parameter over the ~19,000-game catalog returns a bounded page of games with no game id repeated across two consecutive pages, and the reported total equals the number of distinct games stored
requirements.notes: Thousand-row case of the lobby list; also protects against offset drift when the catalog is resynced.

requirements.statement: After a slot round finishes in /playslot, the RUB balance in the fixed header shows the new stored balance without a manual page reload
requirements.notes: Build lists 'header balance not refreshing after each bet' as a known open item; a player who cannot see the balance cannot trust the game.

requirements.statement: A POST to /wgc_wallet.php carrying an invalid X-WGC-Signature returns HTTP 401 with body invalid_signature and leaves every player balance unchanged
requirements.notes: Money-bearing callback must reject unsigned requests; tests must never attempt to forge a valid signature.

requirements.statement: Two wallet callbacks carrying the same round id apply the bet or win exactly once, so a replayed callback leaves the balance as after the first application
requirements.notes: Replay is the classic way a provider callback creates free money; the agent claims idempotency was verified, which is unverified until checked.

requirements.statement: Every slot bet, win and rollback is stored with its round id, game, player and RUB amounts, and the player's stored balance after the round equals the stored transactions applied in order, to the kopeck
requirements.notes: Agent promised rounds recorded with IDs so they can be found in the admin ID search.

requirements.statement: For every wallet operation the stored balance in kopecks equals the previous balance minus the bet plus the win, and any RUB value shown on screen equals stored kopecks divided by 100 with two decimals
requirements.notes: Tier 2 class 1 (business logic): the app displays and stores RUB, and the build mentions zeroing remaining kopecks when a bonus is cancelled, so kopeck precision is real.

requirements.statement: The «Активный вагер» progress on the profile equals the sum of qualifying bets since activation against the required wager amount, in RUB to the kopeck, never decreases when a bet loses, and the same figure is used to decide whether a withdrawal is blocked
requirements.notes: Tier 2 class 1: two places show the same number and a third enforces it, so they must agree.

requirements.statement: A bet placed through a WGC slot round increases the active wager progress by that bet amount exactly once per round id, and a rollback reverses that increase
requirements.notes: Tier 2 class 1: the agent promised slot bets count toward the wager; a rule enforced on one path and not the others is a domain defect.

requirements.statement: A withdrawal request submitted while the player's wager is unfinished is refused on the server for both withdrawal forms with the balance unchanged, and the same request succeeds once the wager is cleared
requirements.notes: Tier 2 classes 1 and 4: build states withdrawals are blocked while the wager is unfinished; over-refusal must also be catchable, so the cleared case is part of the statement.

requirements.statement: Activating a promo code credits exactly the code's bonus amount to the balance and sets the required wager to bonus multiplied by the code's multiplier, and the profile card shows those two numbers consistently
requirements.notes: Tier 2 class 1: bonus and wager are computed on activation; a wrong multiplier silently changes how much the player must bet.

requirements.statement: A promo code can be activated once per user, an expired or fully-used code is refused with a message and activates nothing, and a fourth different code within 24 hours is refused while the previous three stay active
requirements.notes: Tier 2 class 1: build states one activation per code per user, activation limits, expiry and max 3 different codes per 24h.

requirements.statement: A deposit-type promo code is refused unless the player has a single confirmed deposit of at least the code's minimum within the last 24 hours (zero disables the check), and the refusal shows a message and activates nothing
requirements.notes: Tier 2 class 1: build states «Мин. депозит за 24 ч» requires one deposit of at least that amount, not a sum of several.

requirements.statement: The top header bar with logo and either Войти/Регистрация or the balance and profile controls stays fixed at the top while the page scrolls on home and /slot, and at scroll position zero it covers none of the first row of content
requirements.notes: Tier 2 class 2: build states the header is fixed via css/rubin-theme.css; a fixed bar that overlaps content breaks the primary action underneath it.

requirements.statement: The popular-slots grid on the home page shows nine WGC games with their images and no name overlay, and the first position is a real game rather than an empty card
requirements.notes: Tier 2 class 2: build names an empty first card in «Популярные слоты» as a known open item.

requirements.statement: The query behind the home popular-slots block returns exactly nine games with non-empty image URLs and one entry per game, never a null row that renders as an empty card
requirements.notes: Tier 2 class 2 counterpart: an empty first card is a data defect surfacing as a layout defect.

requirements.statement: The «Оригинальные игры» cards on the home page (Dice, Wheel, Bubbles, Mines) render each image in full at the 3:4 vertical card ratio on phone and desktop without cropping the artwork
requirements.notes: Tier 2 class 2: the first agent report describes new vertical 3:4 cards with compressed images; the claim is unverified.

requirements.statement: The home page serves the four original games with their image paths, declared 3:4 dimensions and a link to each game, and a missing image file yields a fallback rather than a broken tile
requirements.notes: Tier 2 class 2 counterpart.

requirements.statement: At a 390x844 viewport /slot renders the tile grid in three columns with no horizontal scrolling and no tile clipped at the right edge
requirements.notes: Tier 2 class 2: the developer's own test list fixes 390x844 and three columns; without it the 4:3 tiles can overflow the phone width.

requirements.statement: At a desktop viewport /slot shows search, the provider button and the tile grid without overlap or clipping, and the page body never scrolls sideways
requirements.notes: Tier 2 class 2: primary content visible without arranging the window.

requirements.statement: Every slot tile on /slot and in the home popular grid renders the same way — same frame ratio, same image fit, same label placement — so no tile is wider, squarer or differently labelled than its neighbours
requirements.notes: Tier 2 class 2: the same component must render the same on every page; the user's complaints were about cropping and overlays appearing inconsistently.

requirements.statement: Opening /playslot?g=<publicId> directly in a fresh tab while signed in starts that game, reloading the URL starts the same game again, and an unknown or missing g shows an error card with a link back to /slot instead of a blank page
requirements.notes: Tier 2 class 3: deep link into the game screen is how tiles reach it, so it must survive a direct open and a reload.

requirements.statement: After searching and filtering on /slot, browser back and forward restore the previous search text, provider and page, and the grid matches what the URL says
requirements.notes: Tier 2 class 3: filters that survive back navigation and reload; paired with the URL-persistence requirement.

requirements.statement: Opening /slot, changing the provider or paging shows a visible loading state and then the result; when the request fails the page says so in Russian and offers a retry, and never shows a silently empty grid
requirements.notes: Tier 2 class 3: loading, empty and error states must look different from each other.

requirements.statement: For the signed-in administrator /admin/slots renders the WGC key status, the callback URL, a games count above 17,000 and the transaction table, without the operator pressing the full-synchronisation control
requirements.notes: Tier 2 class 3: build describes this surface; full synchronisation must not be triggered during testing because it hits the live provider API.

requirements.statement: The admin slots page reads key status, callback URL, game and slot counts and transaction rows from stored settings and the games and transactions tables, and refuses a request from a non-administrator session
requirements.notes: Tier 2 class 3 counterpart; the same check is the access-control boundary for the admin area.

requirements.statement: The account tst465641 with password Test12345 signs in through POST /action.php type=login or the site login modal and reaches /admin as an administrator
requirements.notes: Seed credential the testing system depends on, taken from the build's required credentials.

requirements.statement: The account rbtest1556 with password Test12345 signs in and is a player whose RUB balance is 0 at the start of the run
requirements.notes: Seed credential and starting balance the testing system depends on; later phases seed from this value.

requirements.statement: Signing in sets a server session that survives a page reload and a new tab and exposes the player's current RUB balance to the header, and signing out ends it so a later request to /playslot or /admin is treated as signed-out
requirements.notes: Tier 2 class 4: header, profile and cashier all read this session's balance.

requirements.statement: A signed-in player requesting /admin or any admin action directly (promo create, edit and delete, slots synchronisation, ID search) is refused server-side and receives none of the admin data or effect
requirements.notes: Tier 2 class 4: the admin panel exists, so the least-privileged role must not reach it by a direct request.

requirements.statement: A signed-in player requesting another player's balance, bet history, deposits, withdrawals or promo activations by direct link or by changing an id is refused and receives none of that data, and no listing or count includes another player's rows
requirements.notes: Tier 2 class 4: profile, history and cashier are per-player; the app holds money, so leakage is also a security defect.

requirements.statement: Searching or paging /slot returns each matching game once across its pages, and the number of results equals the number of distinct matching games stored
requirements.notes: Tier 2 class 5: a list, search or filter must return every matching row once across its pages.

requirements.statement: Админ → «Поиск по ID» resolves an identifier to the matching player, deposit, payment invoice, withdrawal, promo activation or bet, including slot round ids, finds deposits and withdrawals by their record number, and returns no rows for an identifier that does not exist
requirements.notes: Tier 2 class 5: build states ID search covers players, deposits, invoices, withdrawals, promo activations and bets, and is the place WGC round ids must be visible.

requirements.statement: The profile shows «Ваш ID» with the player's own identifier and a «Копировать» button that changes to «Скопировано» and puts that exact identifier on the clipboard
requirements.notes: Tier 2 class 5: the build states this control exists; the copied value must equal the stored id, which is the paranoid form.

requirements.statement: The profile and every deposit and withdrawal record expose the player's identifier and each record's own identifier as stored, so the copied value matches the row the admin search resolves
requirements.notes: Tier 2 class 5 counterpart: a displayed id must equal the stored id it is labelled as.

requirements.statement: A slot tile whose image fails to load shows a placeholder such as the game name or a generic graphic instead of a broken-image icon or a blank gap, and the tile still opens the game
requirements.notes: Tier 2 class 6: images come from an external CDN, so a missing or broken asset must degrade visibly, not silently.

requirements.statement: Slot images are rendered at their declared pixel size inside the tile without being upscaled into a blur or squeezed out of proportion, and the same image keeps its aspect when shown in the home grid
requirements.notes: Tier 2 class 6: provider images are 300x300; the user objected to blur frames and to cropping, so declared-size rendering is the requirement.

requirements.statement: A cashier deposit invoice confirmed by CryptoBot or xRocket credits the RUB balance exactly once, to the kopeck, a cancelled or expired invoice credits nothing, and with CRYPTOBOT_TOKEN or XROCKET_TOKEN unset the method reports itself unavailable instead of showing a fake success
requirements.notes: Tier 2 class 8: the product takes real money and has a cashier; the build states the provider tokens are not set, so the unavailable path is what must be honest.

requirements.statement: The cashier shows a clear message in Russian when a payment method is not configured and shows a credited balance only after the app has recorded the provider's confirmation
requirements.notes: Tier 2 class 8: nothing fails silently and nothing succeeds silently on a money screen.

requirements.statement: When WGC is slow, rate-limited or returns an error, the launch fails with a message the player can read, no balance is debited, and a retry creates no second session and no duplicate charge
requirements.notes: Tier 2 class 9: the provider is a live external service; the app must stay honest and consistent when it is unavailable.

requirements.statement: One click on a tile creates one provider session and one round record; abandoning /playslot and reopening the same game leaves no second live session and no duplicated bet record
requirements.notes: Tier 2 class 9: duplicate sessions are the usual source of duplicate callbacks and double debits.

requirements.statement: A page of the /slot catalog over roughly 19,000 games answers in about the time a handful of rows takes, using the stored indexes rather than loading the whole catalog for each request
requirements.notes: Tier 2 class 11: the catalog size is known from the build, so the lobby must page, not dump.

requirements.statement: Leaving /playslot by back, by closing or by navigating to /slot tears down the game frame and its timers, so returning to the page later keeps one live session and the page answers as fast as the first time
requirements.notes: Tier 2 class 11: an iframe game left alive keeps a session and a timer per visit.

requirements.statement: Every page the navigation reaches (home, /slot, /playslot, profile, cashier, /admin/slots) loads with no PHP warning, notice or fatal error text on screen and no visible script error in the browser
requirements.notes: Tier 2 class 12: the site is PHP 8.2 and was migrated from another environment, so leaked warnings are a realistic failure.

requirements.statement: Each of these routes returns HTTP 200 with rendered content for the role that may see it, and a missing configuration value such as SLOTS_API_SECRET surfaces as a handled message rather than a fatal error or an undefined-index notice
requirements.notes: Tier 2 class 12 counterpart.

requirements.statement: Every configuration value the slots integration reads — SLOTS_API_SECRET, the WGC operator credentials, the API base URL and the callback URL — exists in the preview environment and the integration runs with it, and when one is absent the admin slots page names the missing key
requirements.notes: The user's line confirms the keys were added to the environment; the admin page is described as showing key status, so an absent key must be visible rather than fatal.

requirements.statement: Each slot tile in the lobby shows the game name and its provider as text outside the image, so two games with similar artwork can be told apart
requirements.notes: benchmark: casino lobbies label every tile with game name and provider — the user asked only that the name not sit on top of the artwork.

requirements.statement: Typing in the single search field narrows the grid as the player types, a clear control resets it to the full first page, and the query survives a reload when it is in the URL
requirements.notes: benchmark: lobby search narrows as you type and can be cleared in one click; a search that needs a full page reload per keystroke is not what players of this category use.

requirements.statement: The provider list in the /slot panel contains every provider present in the stored catalog with its game count, and selecting any listed provider returns at least one game
requirements.notes: benchmark: casino lobbies derive the provider filter from the catalog itself, so no stored provider is unreachable through the panel.

requirements.statement: A signed-in player sees the current RUB balance in the fixed header on every page, and that figure equals the balance the profile and cashier show
requirements.notes: benchmark: a casino player always sees the balance they are playing with; three screens showing three numbers is the classic defect of this category.

requirements.statement: The lobby states how many games the current search or provider filter matched, and that number equals the distinct games reachable by paging
requirements.notes: benchmark: casino lobbies report the found-game count so a filter that returned nothing is obvious at a glance.

unmapped_phrases.reason: the secret is redacted in the transcript, so no test can sign a valid wallet callback; only its absence from pages, bundles, responses and logs can be asserted
a process marker between messages, not a product behaviour; nothing to test
